csv_project_name: DB for High School Gymnasium Project
csv_scope_of_work: The purpose of this Request for Proposals is to seek the service of qualified Mechanical/Structural Engineers/HVAC contractors to design, provide and install new air conditioning to the High School Gymnasium. The proposal is to add roof top units and reinforce the existing structure to support the new units. The contractor is to provide a complete working system, including, but not limited to roof curbs, ductwork, startup and controls.
